drafts.text: Qwenputer builds a RISC-V CPU into Qwen3.5-4B's weights, using its Gated DeltaNet layers as RAM, so it runs C and MicroPython inside the forward pass. Reported DeepMind math: 97.5-100% vs 55-90% for the base model. One reproduction on an RTX 5090 printed all 61 digits of 2**200.
drafts.why: A new capability with released weights, a benchmark comparison and an independent reproduction.

drafts.text: OpenTTD-Bench puts four frontier agents in one shared OpenTTD game for ten game years (about 3 real hours), scored on operating profit. GPT-6.1 Sol and GPT-6 Astra lead the models, but none beats the scripted rules-based AI yet. Code is open.
drafts.why: A long-horizon, real-time agent eval with open code and a clear non-AI baseline the models still lose to.

drafts.text: Scale AI and Hugging Face released FineART: 40K+ robot demonstrations across 151 real-world tasks with 500K subtask labels, plus FineART-VLA, a model that reasons over step-by-step actions. Both are open on LeRobot.
drafts.why: A large open robotics dataset and checkpoint anyone can train or benchmark on today.
